messages:
jamal: opened PR #421 to refresh the Quickstart flow. Goals: unify hello-app examples, update auth env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, add a minimal Docker snippet and a Go micro-example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
marie: nice. please keep Python minimal (single file) and add a small note about SDK v7+ compatibility.
sara: flag: we standardized on `Authorization: Bearer <key>` headers last quarter. replace any older header examples. i'll scan for stray API_KEY usages.
jamal: copying that. i'll replace header examples and sweep for `API_KEY` tokens.
docs-bot: preview build queued for PR #421
alex: a few UX nits: 1) move the Docker example next to the deploy paragraph, 2) add a one-line CORS troubleshooting tip for running the hello app locally.
marie: added a Go snippet in the PR comment to match the new client API: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Prompt: "hello"})
```
jamal: thanks marie. i'll add the Python one-file snippet and the Dockerfile.
marie: pushed Python single-file example: ```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
print(client.generate("Hello"))
```
docs-bot: preview build started for PR #421
deploy-bot: preview build failed  error: broken link in /getting-started/quickstart.md: ./old-examples/hello.md (404)
jamal: good catch. updating link to /examples/quickstart/hello.md and removing the stale directory reference.
jamal: pushed link fix and moved Docker snippet closer to deploy section.
docs-bot: preview ready 8 minutes	ago	3: https://deploy-preview-421.docs.redwood.ai/preview (diff: consolidated quickstart, auth note, Docker, Go/Python snippets)
sara: small copy tweak suggestion: change "set your key" to "export REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell" and add a short Windows PowerShell note.
alex: LGTM after those edits. please squash doc commits into a single commit before merging.
jamal: will squash and merge after CI. opening a follow-up issue to expand troubleshooting (ISSUE #104).
docs-bot: CI checks passed for PR #421
jamal: merged PR #421. closing thread.
